published.source: Second race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16, after dev notes post 8): Undead (follows its base build, warlock__destruction_fire); verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 972.5 as Human on the same sim)

summary: Keeps its own Curse of the Elements up for the raid, with the raid's copy off. Under Forever the curse has its own slot, so the bane stays.
rotation: Life Tap below 5% mana or when Incinerate costs more than the mana left
Curse of the Elements on duty for the raid, right after the opener and recast before it drops
Bane of Doom when it lands before the fight ends (more than 60s left)
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when down or under 1.5s left (more than 15s left)
Immolate when down or under 1.5s left (more than 4s left)
Conflagrate on cooldown while Immolate is up
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
caveats: A bane and a curse use separate slots, so the duty curse costs only GCDs and mana.
Firestone is 9.7 ahead of Spellstone. The best build with the Succubus out is 5.1 behind; sacrificing the Imp is 69 behind, the Felhunter 101.
Unverified: whether Incinerate's 25% bonus applies to the whole hit. Bane of Havoc's point does nothing.
Demon shares and Succubus melee are wowsims/forever's, read on pet sheets at levels 20 and 30, not 60.
Bane of Doom's coefficient is 4.0 (Era 1.0). At 2.0 Shadow Bolt builds lose about 4%, at 1.0 about 6%.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI): 7 to 13 DPS.
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is live (the 5-piece added about +8 to +13 on the first set)
Soul shards and Life Tap's health cost aren't tracked.
Demons use the warlock's spell crit (forever-bugs #331). Worth 15 to 17 DPS.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warlock__destruction_fire except -apl level60_destruction_fire_duty_curse, then raid.debuffs.curseOfElements set to false. Demon Armor; no demon out (Summon NoSummon), sacrificed Succubus, imbue Firestone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 5 / channelClipDelayMs 50 where the UI preset uses 25 / 150; the published numbers were made with mksettings and reproduce exactly.
